recommendation: Use a mixed deterministic-first architecture with one semantic/QA/versioning contract across routes.
alternatives: one universal SVG pipeline; CAD/3D everywhere; human illustration everywhere; generative-first
stability: architecture stable in principle; route mix unmeasured
blocking_items: 24-candidate evidence-bearing pilot; measured accepted-scene labor/failure rates
handoff: R2.90 should carry this as the preferred candidate, not a production approval.

recommendation: Use one exact unannotated immutable static scene view for a scored attempt.
alternatives: interactive 3D; animated scene; multiple pre-answer views
blocking_items: phone/print/readability testing per scene
handoff: Implementation pins exact asset/view hash; interactive 3D is unnecessary for v1 scoring.

recommendation: Author a semantic scene manifest before art; require semantic manifest, final reviewed pixels, and region map to agree.
alternatives: derive semantics from pixels; illustrator-only notes; runtime vision inference
blocking_items: content-schema integration and pilot authoring ergonomics
handoff: Content compiler should validate closure and review state.

recommendation: Prefer modular project-owned SVG/2D composition.
blocking_items: pilot classes P1/P2/P5/P7; anti-template review
handoff: Adopt only for classes whose measured quality/throughput justify it.

recommendation: Prefer project-owned Blender/procedural 3D blocking with deterministic static line rendering.
blocking_items: Blender render/readability/line-style and repeat-build results
handoff: Refresh/pin Blender at pilot time; do not ship Blender/runtime 3D to learners.

recommendation: Use deterministic 3D blocking plus constrained human 2D cleanup when raw 3D is too rigid/noisy.
blocking_items: semantic-drift/rework rate and hotspot invalidation cost
handoff: Cleanup edits that affect semantic geometry trigger full re-review/versioning.

recommendation: Use as selective fallback/specialist route from a deterministic blocking package, with explicit rights terms.
blocking_items: current quote/contract terms; rights review; pilot labor
handoff: Do not assume payment alone transfers copyright.

recommendation: Exclude from controlling scored-scene production.
blocking_items: none for exclusion; future evidence could reopen
handoff: Prompt/seed/model pinning is insufficient for zero-accidental-hazard and preservation authority.

recommendation: Permit only optional pilot R&D from project-owned deterministic structural inputs; keep deterministic pre-generation render controlling/fallback.
blocking_items: structural gates; provider/model rights; accepted-scene labor benefit
handoff: No provider/checkpoint selected; normal builds must not depend on it.

recommendation: Human-author normalized target/decoy polygons after final scene semantic acceptance; never infer hazards at scoring time.
alternatives: computer vision hotspots; object bounding boxes; semantic SVG elements exposed pre-answer
blocking_items: pilot tolerance and blind-marker dispersion
handoff: Implementation must keep semantic polygon truth separate from display tolerance.

recommendation: Pilot a display-space tolerance starting near 12 CSS px at 1x with a 1.5% short-edge cap, rejecting semantic overlap.
alternatives: fixed normalized-only tolerance; object-sized giant hotspots
blocking_items: real marker data on small phones; overlap tests
handoff: Numeric values are not standards and must be replaced/tuned by pilot evidence.

recommendation: One stable neutral zone order drives pre-answer description, nonvisual equivalent, post-answer feedback, visual numbering, and print key.
blocking_items: representative screen-reader/keyboard/print testing
handoff: Zone ordering must not reveal hazard importance/count.

recommendation: Provide a neutral zoned equivalent testing the same underlying concepts, but report visual and nonvisual formats separately.
blocking_items: assistive-technology usability testing
handoff: Do not claim it is the identical visual-recognition construct.

recommendation: Use stable HSP-* release-blocking failure codes and an independent accidental-hazard/decoy review.
blocking_items: pilot reviewer calibration
handoff: A scene cannot average away one critical failure.

recommendation: Version semantic inventory, scored view, regions, accessibility, derivatives, and item references separately; never overwrite historical attempts.
alternatives: mutable latest asset; recompute old results
blocking_items: schema/compiler implementation tests
handoff: Camera, hotspot, decoy, or meaning changes invalidate different dependent artifacts per VERSIONING-CONTRACT.md.

recommendation: Vary camera/location/safe clutter while preserving the exact admitted safety rule; independently re-author/review final regions.
alternatives: reuse identical hotspot coordinates; only recolor/relabel same template
blocking_items: pilot variant labor and location-shortcut metrics
handoff: Family-level target/zone distributions should be reviewed to prevent template memorization.

recommendation: Ship only reviewed static learner assets plus compact interaction/accessibility/content data; keep authoring masters/diagnostic passes out of learner packs.
blocking_items: actual pilot asset sizes and bundling/offline lane integration
handoff: No Blender/model/provider runtime dependency is required.

recommendation: Treat scene validation/rendering as build/content-production responsibilities within the Bun workspace; preserve specialist external tools when justified.
blocking_items: final monorepo graph and content-compiler decision
handoff: Effect only where capability/failure/resource semantics justify it; no code-level API choice made by R2.9.

recommendation: Record effect@4.0.0-rc.111, Bun 1.4.0, Blender 5.2.0 LTS as dated R2.9 coordinates; refresh before pilot/implementation.
blocking_items: future release drift
handoff: No Effect/Bun/Blender runtime probe was necessary or performed by this documentation/research lane.

recommendation: Approve no production scene and no bulk scene program from R2.9 alone.
alternatives: begin bulk production from research recommendation
blocking_items: evidence-bearing pilot plus normal content/source/rights/accessibility review
handoff: Research establishes architecture candidate and gates, not certified assets.
